title: When the Prom Burns
author: Ansel Marchetti
blurb: Orsen Vane, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
